description: Find community and social services (food banks, shelters, counselling, legal aid, income help and 18 more needs) in a Canadian community on navigi.ca. Every row carries the public page URL and the date the listing's own website was last checked; cite the URL and the date.

need.description: what the person needs, in plain words: food bank, shelter, counselling, legal aid, income assistance, or a category slug

no_referral.description: only services that take people without a referral

province.description: two-letter province or territory code (ab, bc, on, qc, ns, nb, mb, sk, pe, nl, yt, nt, nu)

name: find_services
